blocks.text: Stratosphere mein ozone ki concentration ka kam hona depletion of ozone (ozone ka kam hona) kehlata hai. Yeh depletion kuch organic compounds ki wajah se hui hai jinhen chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) kehte hain. Yeh compounds kamre ke temperature par gas ya jaldi ubalne wale liquids hote hain aur aerosols (spray) ya refrigerants (fridge mein thanda karne wali cheezen) ke taur par istemal hote hain.

CFCs phail kar stratosphere tak pohnch jate hain, jahan UV radiations unhen tor deti hain aur chlorine free radical (Cl•, chlorine ka woh atom jis mein ek akela electron ho) banta hai. Yeh chlorine free radical in reactions ke zariye ozone molecule ko torta hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'chloride free radical' likhti hai. Chloride to ion (Cl⁻) hota hai; UV se banne wala particle chlorine free radical (Cl•) hai, jaisa ke kitab khud agle paragraph mein kehti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne teesra step ClO• + O₂ → Cl• + O₂ chhapa hai, jo balanced nahi (baen taraf 3 O atoms, daen taraf 2). Sahi step ClO• + O → Cl• + O₂ hai: oxygen atom (O) ClO• se oxygen le kar O₂ banata hai aur Cl• azad ho kar dobara ozone torta hai.
Aakhri step mein dobara chlorine free radical banta hai jo ozone (O₃) ka ek aur molecule tor sakta hai. Is tarah doosra aur teesra step bohat baar dohraye jate hain.

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: CFCs aerosols mein propellant (spray ko bahar dhakelne wali gas) aur refrigerators aur air conditioners mein coolant ke taur par istemal hote hain. Kitab ke mutabiq CFCs garmi ko atmosphere se bahar jane se rokne mein CO₂ se 100,000 guna zyada effective hain hain. CFC ka ek molecule tootne par ozone ke 100,000 tak molecules destroy (tabah) kar sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: CFCs aur ozone layer ke depletion par short note likhein.
blocks.explanation: CFCs refrigerants aur aerosol propellants mein istemal hote the. Yeh itne kam reactive hain ke bach kar stratosphere tak pohnch jate hain, jahan UV light C–Cl bond tor kar Cl• chhorti hai. Cl• ozone ko O₂ mein badalta hai aur ClO• + O se dobara ban jata hai, is liye ek chlorine atom bar bar ozone torta hai, ek CFC molecule se 100,000 tak. Is se woh layer patli hoti hai jo hamein UV se bachati hai.

items: CFCs (propellants, refrigerants) stratosphere tak pohnchte hain; UV se Cl• banta hai.
Cl• + O₃ → ClO• + O₂ aur ClO• + O → Cl• + O₂ bar bar: ek CFC molecule 100,000 tak ozone molecules tor sakta hai.
